messages:
Maya: Heads-up — CrescentAI showing a sharp drop in API usage starting 2024-06-21. Their main advocate (Nina) moved to a new role last week and procurement just told us they're evaluating VendorX. Can we triage?
Jon: Ack. Do we have token counts and which endpoints dropped?
Maya: Quick numbers from the dashboard: 
```
Last 7d tokens: 23,400
Prev 7d tokens: 128,900
Top endpoints impacted: /generate (‑74%), /embeddings (‑62%)
Active seats: 8 -> 5 (license pause)
```
Maya: Their success playbook was the embed indexing batch job + chat assistants. Both job runs stopped after the advocacy change.
Sam: Thanks — probable causes: 1) lost champion, 2) procurement cost push, 3) they hit latency spikes on long sequences last month. I can pull traces for the 2 long /generate requests that timed out.
Priya: Onboarding checklist shows 3 outstanding items: SSO test, KV cache tuning, and dedicated batch window config. I flagged the ticket to the integration team yesterday.
Jon: Can we propose a short rescue: 1) offer a 30d dedicated trial (no commit) focused on embeds throughput, 2) a small bill credit for the week they lost traffic, 3) schedule a 30m reinstatement call with the new PM?
Maya: Good list. Customer asked for concise ROI numbers to present to procurement — can someone quickly estimate token cost delta if they move to VendorX vs remaining with our optimized batching?
Sam: I can model that. Need typical seq len + QPS. From logs: avg seq len 850 tokens, steady-state QPS ~0.6 during business hours.
Sam: Rough calc: our current batched run (with KV caching) cost ~= $0.0036/token-equivalent for their workload. VendorX published price looks ~0.0055/token for similar model. If they keep current volume that's ~20% monthly spend difference. I'll paste a short chart in the customer-ready note.
OpsBot: Alert: account signal flagged — usage drop >60% and advocate change detected. Playbook suggested: "rescue outreach".
Maya: I'll draft the outreach (short email + deck). Jon — can you own the procurement-facing ROI slide? Priya — can you confirm if we can proactively enable a temporary dedicated pool for their account next week? Sam — assemble traces + latency fix recommendations.
Jon: On it. Sending a one‑pager by EOD.
Priya: Checking infra availability now. If approved, we can enable a 1-week dedicated pool (small) starting Mon.
Sam: Will gather traces and a 2‑line remediation (KV tuning + quantization profile).
Maya: Meeting to sync at 11:30 PT tomorrow. If we can get the ROI slide + infra confirm before then, I'll loop in the new PM and procurement.
Jon: Also recommend offering a short proof: demo their slow query fixed in <30s. That should win procurement time.
Maya: Agreed. Tagging @ProcurementTeam in the follow-up doc.
Maya: Quick note for record: action items -> Jon: ROI slide; Priya: infra enablement; Sam: traces + remediation; Maya: customer outreach + meeting invite.
Sam: +1.
Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
